|lore=Kadas’sa’Nikto. One of Jabba’s best pilots. Often pilots Jabba’s space yacht. '''Smuggler'''. Prefers to be flying combat starfighters.
|game_text=Adds 3 to power of anything he pilots. Wooof may deploy with any cruiser using Combat Response. When deployed, may draw top card from Reserve Deck. During your deploy phase, if piloting Jabba’s Space Cruiser, may deploy one Jabba aboard (for free) from Reserve Deck; reshuffle.
|printings={{Card versions/Wooof}}
|notes=The Set 8 slips preserve the earlier presentation of Wooof. Both slips retain the Combat Response pairing, top-card draw on deployment, and the free Jabba download while piloting the cruiser. The later wording names the ordinary owner deploy phase for the singular pull.
